A hospital plans to develop a database system to manage information about   departments,   doctors,   and   patients. Each department has a unique dept_ID, dept_name, and location. Every department employs multiple doctors. Each doctor has a unique doctor_ID, doctor_name,, expertise and phone number. A doctor works in exactly one department. The hospital maintains records of all patients. For each patient, the system stores patient_ID (unique), patient_name (f_name, l_name) DOB, age, address, and multiple phone numbers. Each patient is assigned to exactly one department, and a department can have many patients. Patients can consult multiple doctors, and each doctor can consult many patients. The hospital also maintains information about each patient’s attendant. For every attendant, the system stores A_Name, relation, phone, and address. Each patient must have at least one attendant, and each attendant is responsible for exactly one patient. Tasks to be include in ER diagram: 1. Design the ER diagram with proper notation. 2. Identify   entities,   attributes (including multivalued and composite), and relationships. 3. Specify cardinality and participation constraints.
